prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A sharply dressed man in a black suit, white shirt, and black tie stands confidently behind a desk with two computer monitors in a brightly lit car dealership showroom. His expression is animated, as if he is in the middle of an enthusiastic sales pitch or presentation. The background features large, wall-mounted delivery report boards filled with colorful charts and handwritten notes, adding a sense of busy activity and business tracking. Two orange balloons float on either side of the man, contributing a festive, promotional atmosphere. The foreground includes office supplies, paperwork, and folders scattered on round desks, emphasizing a working environment. Behind the glass partition, several cars in vibrant colors—yellow, white, and black—are visible, parked inside the showroom under warm, even lighting. The overall color palette is a mix of cool blues and teals from the walls and glass, contrasted with the warm oranges and yellows of the balloons and cars. The camera angle is eye-level, with a wide aspect ratio that captures the bustling, energetic mood of a busy dealership, and a moderate depth of field keeps both the man and the background details in sharp focus. The style is cinematic, reminiscent of a modern workplace comedy or drama, with a clean, professional look and a hint of playful chaos.
